completionEvidence.description: Created internal qcow2 snapshot phase0-snap1 and confirmed it in qemu-img snapshot -l.
After snapshot, SSH created /var/lib/aib-after-snap; qemu-img snapshot -a phase0-snap1 then rebooted.
After restore, test ! -e /var/lib/aib-after-snap succeeded while the original cloud-init boot marker remained.

notes: Snapshot was taken while the VM was stopped. Live snapshot and shared-VM multi-project impact are separate later tests.
